_comment: Identical to lighthouserc.json since W145: R50's localhost LCP waiver is retired. It existed only because Lantern's pessimistic graph charged the whole early payload to the paint over a sub-60 ms localhost waterfall (~2.7 s on every path while the observed LCP was ~50 ms); under DevTools throttling a local run measures a real throttled paint (~1.5 s), so LCP is an error here as everywhere. gate.sh still passes this file to lhci collect and lhci assert when E2E_BASE_URL is localhost and the target wears the production face (lighthouseConfigFor, e2e/helpers/face.ts; W137): it stays the one place a localhost-only difference would go. A local run is fast feedback; the run against the Vercel preview is binding (docs/OPERATING.md). The script ceiling is 204,800 B here too (W13 amended). W145 (closes W141): LCP and performance are measured under DevTools throttling (collect.settings.throttlingMethod "devtools"), three runs per path (collect.numberOfRuns), asserted on the median of the three (assert.aggregationMethod "median"). Lighthouse's default simulated throttling (Lantern) charges the whole initial waterfall (framework ~121 KB + next-intl ~17 KB + two Archivo files ~68 KB + CSS) to a text LCP element that has no resource of its own, so a placeholder page read ~2.9-3.0 s while its observed paint under real throttling is ~1.55 s; the LCP and performance assertions keep their values and now judge a real, throttled paint.
